asset_description: Cloud endpoint that distributes firmware updates to vehicles over-the-air
Real-time telemetry data including location GPS speed and diagnostics transmitted to backend
OBD-II remote diagnostic capability allowing service technicians to read DTCs remotely
Cryptographic keys used to secure TLS connections between vehicle and backend server
Central gateway ECU bridging infotainment CAN and powertrain CAN networks
JWT token issued to authenticated users for accessing vehicle mobile app features
